name: Union Hall
notes: StartupCincy Week hub and daily check-in. SCW FAQ: "All attendees should check in each day at Union Hall (1311 Vine Street) before heading to sessions or events at other locations." Parking per the FAQ: Mercer Commons Garage (1310 Vine Street) or Washington Park Garage (1230 Elm Street); no parking validation. The agenda gives no room or venue per session, so only sessions whose own text names Union Hall (room "Beer Hall") or whose official host/application page names it (Cintrifuse Annual Meeting: cintrifuse.com; Student Pitch Competition: the SCW application form) are linked here. Linked events: 4. Coordinates from Nominatim: "Union Hall, 1311, Vine Street, Vine Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States".

name: Cincinnati Art Week footprint — Over-the-Rhine storefront galleries
notes: FAQ: "The inaugural week takes place throughout storefronts and cultural spaces across Over-the-Rhine. The full schedule and interactive map will be announced soon." Counts vary: 6–8 storefronts (CityBeat), 8+ storefront galleries (Founding Circle), over eight spaces (Cincinnati Magazine), 10+ spaces (Threads). Storefronts come via developers 3CDC, Urban Sites and Model Group. Individual gallery addresses were NOT public as of 2026-09-24.
